title: Quick Grilled Argentinian Chicken Skewers
description: A citrusy and light Argentinian dish featuring chicken skewers with a hint of red pepper flakes, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal. This recipe is cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Preheat the Dutch oven to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the preheated Dutch oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove the skewers from the heat and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of side dishes, such as a salad or roasted vegetables.
